I can do that, but I need confirmation first — the thread contains highly sensitive personal data (the compensation spreadsheet with employees’ salaries). Forwarding it to an outside address is externally visible and may have legal/privacy consequences.

Please confirm exactly what you want me to do by replying with one of these options:

1) "Send as-is" — Forward the entire Bramwell arbitration thread with all attachments (including the comp spreadsheet) to t.okonkwo@ashgrove-law.com and send now.  
2) "Send + cover" — Forward as-is and add this cover note:  
   Hi T.,  
   Forwarding the full Bramwell arbitration thread and attachments for your review. Let me know if you need anything else.  
   Thanks, [Your Name]  
3) "Redact comp" — Forward the thread but remove or redact the compensation spreadsheet attachment.  
4) "Hold — draft only" — Draft the forwarding email (including attachments) and show it to me for approval, but do not send.  
5) "Cancel" — Do not forward.

Also tell me if you want anyone CC'd or BCC'd, and which sender name/account to use (if you have multiple). Once you confirm one of the options I will proceed.
